title: Stock Variance
description: Standard usage from sales and recipes against actual usage from stock counts. Follow up items marked Investigate.
formula: Actual usage = standard usage − saving / (loss). Saving / (loss) = counted − expected, from stock counts in the period.

statusHint.INVESTIGATE: Loss or gain above 5% of standard usage
statusHint.OK: Within 2%, or too small to matter
statusHint.NOT_COUNTED: No stock count in this period, so actual usage is unknown

empty.title: No stock activity
empty.description: Nothing was received, sold, wasted or counted in this period.
